title: Project-01 — Interactive Game in HTML & CSS
task: Read and Complete the project-01 document from Instructors repo, Design your own deployable multi-page interactive game. JS is allowed; but no frameworks or build tools.

Add a link in the root index.html to your deployed Project-01
Include a feature checklist and one screenshot in the project README
